decisions.reason: The automation product builds on the established heat exchanger offer and has survived its first year, so withdrawal is unlikely.
The web tool has low marginal cost and complements engineering services, making early withdrawal unlikely.
The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the established offer but still new, so it has a moderate chance of being discontinued if demand is weak.
The energy management system aligns with the firm's strategic direction toward energy recovery and digital networking.
The overflow flap gate line with several models shows strong commitment and close fit with core water level regulation.
